Elaine: Hey team — final run-of-show draft below. Need confirmations by EOD so we can lock slides + speaker notes. :calendar:

Sam: Taking a look now. Do we still have 6 mins for live demo? We agreed 8 last week.

Ashley: We cut it to 6 to keep Q&A long. Speakers want 7 each—can we adjust?

Diego: For live demo, 6 min strict. If model is slow we'll fall back to recorded snippet. I'll stage the recording in GCS: gs://redwood-webinars/recordings/demo-v1.mp4

Nina: Ops note — prod traffic will be disabled for demo; use sandbox endpoints. Also routing: inbound leads go to #sales-inbound and HubSpot form id `hs_form_420`.

Sam: OK. Suggest: switch to a 5+2 format (5 live, 2 pre-recorded fallback). Keeps timing tight.

Elaine: Love that. Updated run-of-show pasted below — please confirm your cue lines.

``` 
00:00 - 00:05 - Welcome & intro (Elaine)
00:05 - 00:20 - Customer story + benchmarks (Sam)
00:20 - 00:34 - Panel: model tradeoffs (Ashley, Diego) each 7m
00:34 - 00:40 - Live demo (Diego) 5m + 2m fallback
00:40 - 00:50 - Roadmap + product plug (Sam)
00:50 - 01:00 - Live Q&A (All) + closing (Elaine)
```

Ashley: My panel slides are in Figma: https://figma.com/file/abc123/panel-slides — I'll export notes by tomorrow.

Diego: I'll add the demo fallback clip to the shared drive and tag @Ashley when it's ready.

WebinarBot: Recording scheduled for 2026-04-02T16:00Z. Reminder set for 1 hour before.

Nina: For rehearsals — do we want a full dress rehearsal (slides + demo) and a tech check? I propose:
- Tue 14:00 UTC: Tech check (hosts, AV)
- Wed 16:00 UTC: Dress rehearsal (everyone)

Elaine: Agreed. Please RSVP to the calendar invites. Also, follow-up sequence:
- Immediate: Thank-you email + recording + CTA to trial (marketing track)
- Day+3: Benchmarks deep-dive doc (gated via HS form `hs_form_420`)
- Week+2: SDR outreach for high-engage leads

Sam: We'll need a short landing page blurb for the benchmarks asset. I'll draft tonight.

Ashley: I'll run through speaker one-pagers and send to panel by EOD.

Elaine: Perfect — if no objections I'll lock schedule at 18:00 PT. :thumbsup:

Sam: :thumbsup:

Diego: :thumbsup:

Nina: :thumbsup:
